research_notes: Blocked after official roster, direct interview, contemporaneous hospital bio, trustee accounts and targeted hours searches: missing dates/hours at early brokerage, individual FTE in banking/policy work and leave boundaries.

ASFA interview describes six years maternity leave without exact endpoints and compresses subsequent employment chronology. Do not count an uninterrupted twenty-year career or back-calculate leave dates from children, titles or elections.

AustralianSuper's 2016 trustee accounting classification differs from nonprofit legal structures at some other funds. Retained as privately controlled financial-services employment candidate, subject to precise employing entity and FTE verification.
Non-executive directorships are excluded even where government controls the organisation. Neither unknown headline becomes zero.

Follow-up2026-10-03: Fed Square's 2014–15 directors' report resolves the governance interval as 26 September 2014–15 June 2015 and confirms meeting attendance. This supersedes the earlier unresolved conflict between the prospective September2014 welcome and the parliamentary biography's year-only2015 label; governance remains excluded from employment headlines.

Searches of historical governance reports and public financial-services profiles did not resolve banking/policy FTE or six-year leave boundaries. Financial Standard profile was subscription-only; no bypass attempted. APH retirement-inquiry footnotes open returned Internal Error; indexed hearing reference remains a lead only.

Next leads: individual employer appointment/FTE records for banking and AustralianSuper, original brokerage name, and six-year maternity-leave endpoints. Totals remain unknown; excluded governance is not employment.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Hume's public professional profile refines her NAB private-banker role to August1998–June1999 (11 months). The month labels materially narrow one banking interval but do not establish exact start/end days, substantive full-time status or leave. Searches did not recover equivalent month-level evidence for NAFM, Rothschild, Deutsche Bank or AustralianSuper, and the six-year maternity-leave boundaries remain unresolved.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Recovered a previously omitted Menzies Research Centre directorship with exact25 January2018–7 June2019 boundaries in its2019 financial report. Added four official qualifications and eleven dated party offices separately from employment; no qualification dates inferred from derivative biographies. The2013 Couchman scholarship is an award, not proof of paid work or a dated study spell. Targeted indexed qualifications searches did not resolve banking FTE, exact leave endpoints or the brokerage employer. Next avenues remain employer appointment/FTE records and individual leave evidence. Both headline totals remain unknown.

2026-10-05 new hours evidence: personal WCP interview, Q3, says she returned part-time after childcare/study breaks and that directorships did not pay superannuation. Absence of superannuation is not proof of unpaid board service. Working year 1992 is a career commencement statement, not an exact day or independently named brokerage interval. Original status/leave records needed to allocate the partial-work periods; do not count all senior finance roles as full-time.

Follow-up 5 October 2026: added first-person 2021 interview supplying 1992 workforce-start year and explicit post-break part-time work, while leaving employer-specific allocation unknown. This is substantive hours/leave evidence, not a licence to mark all later jobs part-time or infer exact breaks. Targeted banking, father brokerage and AustralianSuper contract searches still lack payroll/FTE records. Current NAB policies and aggregate staff leave do not apply retrospectively to her; a 2015 witness-title observation does not establish appointment date. Next individual status/leave documentation and early brokerage name, rather than repeated senior-title biographies. No numerical total calculated.
